direction.camera: Guide attention with red field; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: place one dark focal form against an intense red field; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with psychological tension; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with dramatic cut.
direction.lighting: narrow red practical; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: black steel and red lacquer; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around slow pressure; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use red field,psychological tension,hard silhouette,small highlight,slow pressure,dramatic cut as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
